description: Search people by name to return candidates, then select a person_id to list their cast, guest, or crew credits. Name searches never select a person automatically. Credits preserve source order and page at 50 rows by default, up to 250 per call; show_id chains to tvmaze_get_show or tvmaze_get_episodes, and guest episode_id chains to tvmaze_get_cast with scope "episode".

credit_kind.description: Credit category for person_id only. Defaults to cast.

cursor.description: Previous next_cursor for person_id only; the current limit sets page size.

limit.description: Page size for person_id only. Defaults to 50; requests above 250 are clamped to 250.

person_id.description: TVmaze person id from tvmaze_get_cast or this tool’s candidates.

query.description: Person name to search. Supply query or person_id, never both. Blank is unset.

name: tvmaze_get_person

candidates.description: Name search candidates, in source order. Never automatically selected.

birthday.description: Date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD, when recorded.

id.description: TVmaze person id; pass as person_id to select this person.

match_score.description: Source relevance score within this search.

url.description: Canonical TVmaze person page; retain for attribution.

cap.description: Applied page size or possible source search ceiling.

credit_kind.description: Credit category returned for the selected person.

credits.description: Selected credits on this page, in source order.

as_self.description: Whether the person appears as themselves, when recorded.

character_url.description: Canonical TVmaze character page when embedded.

episode_id.description: TVmaze episode id for tvmaze_get_cast with scope "episode".

episode_name.description: Episode title on guest credits when available.

episode_url.description: Canonical TVmaze episode page for attribution.

show_id.description: TVmaze show id for tvmaze_get_show or tvmaze_get_episodes.

show_url.description: Canonical TVmaze show page for attribution.

voice_only.description: Whether the role is voice-only, when recorded.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `person_not_found`: The supplied TVmaze person id does not exist. `person_search_unavailable`: Person search did not respond after retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

kind.description: Search candidates or one selected person with credits.

next_cursor.description: Continuation token for the selected credit list.

notice.description: Candidate selection, empty result, paging, and clamp guidance.

birthday.description: Date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD, when recorded.

id.description: TVmaze person id; pass as person_id to select this person.

url.description: Canonical TVmaze person page; retain for attribution.

shown.description: Actual number of candidates or credits returned.

totalCount.description: Candidates returned by search, or total selected credits before paging.

truncated.description: More credits remain, or the source may have capped search candidates.

title: Get person
